title: Java Volata - Review - Zona3

takeaways.text: Integrated carbon bar, Shimano 105 Di2 with 52/36 and 11–34, 28 mm tires on 40 mm alloy wheels, press-fit bottom bracket and the Di2 battery in the carbon seatpost.
Part of JAVA's J-AIR family; the reviewer repeats a Toray T1000 carbon claim and notes oversized straight tubes with a tall, wide head tube.
The wide fork spacing leaves room he estimates for 25, 28 or 32 mm tires (not tested).
Balanced for climbing and holding cruising speed; on a long Santiago climb the wide gearing worked well, and he rates it strong on price for value.

disclosure: Zona3 reviews bikes sold through a Chilean shop; the test bike has Shimano 105 Di2 rather than the candidate's mechanical R7120. Spanish automatic captions.
summary: A Chilean ride review of the JAVA Volata all-round road bike, including a hill test.
